SELECT short_domain_row.id, short_domain_row.host, short_domain_row.name, short_domain_row.status = 1 AS enabled, short_domain_row.state_revision AS revision, short_domain_row.created_at AS createdAt, short_domain_row.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM t_short_domain short_domain_row WHERE ( #{criteria.canReadAll} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_short_domain direct_grant WHERE direct_grant.user_id = #{criteria.actorUserId} AND direct_grant.short_domain_id = short_domain_row.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_role user_role JOIN t_role_short_domain role_grant ON role_grant.role_id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{criteria.actorUserId} AND role_grant.short_domain_id = short_domain_row.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_short_domain_group user_group JOIN t_short_domain_group_member group_domain ON group_domain.short_domain_group_id = user_group.short_domain_group_id WHERE user_group.user_id = #{criteria.actorUserId} AND group_domain.short_domain_id = short_domain_row.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_role user_role JOIN t_role_short_domain_group role_group ON role_group.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_short_domain_group_member group_domain ON group_domain.short_domain_group_id = role_group.short_domain_group_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{criteria.actorUserId} AND group_domain.short_domain_id = short_domain_row.id ) )
AND short_domain_row.status = CASE WHEN #{criteria.enabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
AND ( POSITION(lower(#{criteria.searchTerm}) IN lower(short_domain_row.host)) > 0 OR POSITION(lower(#{criteria.searchTerm}) IN lower(COALESCE(short_domain_row.name, ''))) > 0 )
AND (short_domain_row.created_at, short_domain_row.id) < (#{criteria.cursorCreatedAt}, #{criteria.cursorId})
ORDER BY short_domain_row.created_at DESC, short_domain_row.id DESC LIMIT #{criteria.fetchSize}
